note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Design and silhouette are preserved, but at 1:1 the white stars and white stripe carry a soft grey halo, and the circular rim edge is slightly wavy.
flags.fix: Tighten the per-ink coverage edge so it falls back to the original hard edge; remove the halo band around the white inks and re-threshold the rim alpha.

flags.problem: The 1:1 centre crop is near-featureless dark murk with little steel micro-grain. It reads smoother than the streaked original, and the lab-inject grain looks too weak to read as Metal028 at 1:1.
flags.fix: Raise the Metal028 grain injection (masked to the dark areas) so the 1:1 crop shows visible brushed grain, and keep the vertical streak direction and the bright sprite unchanged.

flags.problem: At 1:1 the grey-tan gravel-mud decal shows repeated vertical oval stamps and smeared vertical streaks that are not in the original. The pattern reads as stamped, not as gravel-mud grit.
flags.fix: Reduce the up_wrap stamp repetition: use a non-repeating or offset Ground049C crop and weaken the vertical lab-inject, keeping the original tan colour and the pink alpha fade at the bottom edge.

flags.problem: Same defect as cbc927de: repeated vertical oval stamps and smeared streaks at 1:1 that the original gravel-mud decal does not have.
flags.fix: Apply the same fix as cbc927de: non-repeating or offset Ground049C crop, weaker vertical lab-inject, original colour and alpha edge kept.
